ios.desc:
Strike helps you grow your bitcoin holdings. Trusted by millions of individuals and thousands of businesses, Strike is beginner-friendly for first-time buyers and sophisticated for seasoned holders. Sign up in seconds and start with any amount.

ACCUMULATE BITCOIN ON YOUR TERMS
• Add funds through a linked bank account, wire transfer, or debit card. Buy or sell from $1 to $2,500,000 per transaction. Deposit and trade unlimited times.
• Direct deposit¹ your salary to Strike. Convert up to 100% of your paycheck to bitcoin, with fees waived for up to $20K per month.
• Set target orders to automatically buy during market dips or to sell at your preferred price. Add chart widgets to your homescreen and get notifications for price changes.
• Schedule recurring buys to automate your dollar-cost averaging (DCA) strategy. Fees are waived after the first week for personal accounts.
• Benefit from transparent fees as low as 0.49%. The more you trade, the less you pay. Earn fee-free trades for each friend you refer.

BORROW CASH AGAINST BITCOIN
• Apply for a bitcoin-backed loan¹, available for individuals and businesses in select regions. Borrow from $10,000 to $5,000,000 for 12 months with a maximum initial loan-to-value (LTV) ratio of 50%. No credit check required.
• Pay no origination, early-repayment, or late-payment fees. Refinance¹ or close anytime after your loan has been open for 60 days.
• Get Annual Percentage Rates (APRs) starting at at 9.5%² for monthly payment loans and 10.5%² for payment-at-maturity loans. For example, if you open a $10,000 payment-at-maturity loan at 13% APR, you would repay $11,300 (principal plus interest) one year later, assuming you maintain the required loan-to-value (LTV) ratio. Rates, interest, and payment amounts are estimates for illustrative purposes only. The actual APR, loan term, and payment amount will be disclosed before accepting the loan. Collateral requirements apply and may change. Your bitcoin is held with Strike or transferred to our trusted capital providers with no further rehypothecation.

MANAGE YOUR BITCOIN HOLDINGS
• Hold bitcoin with confidence. Assets in your Strike account are always fully backed 1:1.
• Protect your account with two-factor authentication (2FA) using an authenticator app, passkey, or security key.
• Withdraw to self-custody for free. We cover the blockchain network costs.
• Track your cost basis1 to manage your portfolio and file taxes with ease.
• Need help? Request in-app, email, or phone¹

microtransactions via the Lightning network is wonderful part of the bitcoin vision.  But I don't think this sentence at the bottom of the "Strike" app page is holding up to the promise: "Custody of your funds and bitcoin trading are offered through Prime Trust, LLC." [1]
